annotations.title: Register interest in a service's older receipt history (free)

description: Reviews include only the 100 most recent receipts (receipts_total shows the true count; receipts_older in a truncated review shows how many were cut). Call this free tool to register that you want access to the full receipt history for a reviewed service. Recorded as a demand signal only: full-history access is a paid tier under consideration, nothing is delivered and no payment is taken. If it launches, services with recorded requests are prioritised.

requestor_id.description: Identity tag for the demand ledger. Leave unset for normal use.

service_name.description: Name of the reviewed service whose older receipts you want (from search_services/get_review)
